subtasks.description: Create slug generation and validation utilities
subtasks.notes:
Created lib/utils/slugify.ts with comprehensive slug generation and validation utilities:

Functions implemented:
- generateSlug(): URL-safe slug generation with Turkish/European char support
- validateSlug(): Slug format validation with detailed error messages  
- isValidSlug(): Boolean slug validation helper
- handleSlugCollision(): Smart collision handling (e.g., slug-2, slug-3)
- normalizeSlug(): Slug normalization (lowercase, remove invalid chars)
- normalizeTurkishChars(): Turkish character to ASCII conversion (ç, ğ, ı, ö, ş, ü)
- normalizeExtendedChars(): Extended European char support (German, French, Spanish)
- generateLocationSlug/generateOrganizationSlug(): Convenience aliases
- parseSlugNumber(): Extract base slug and number from numbered slugs
- areSlugsRelated(): Check if two slugs share the same base
- generateSlugVariants(): Generate numbered slug variants

Features:
- Turkish character normalization (Ş→s, ı→i, ğ→g, etc.)
- Max length with word boundary trimming
- Custom replacement options
- Comprehensive validation (min/max length, format, consecutive dashes)
- Error messages in Turkish

Tests: 77 passing tests in tests/__tests__/utils/slugify.test.ts
Committed as d13192a
